#### Projects

**[HydraLB](https://github.com/DenChicken/HydraLB)** — L3 load balancer on DPDK with Direct Server Return.
Userspace forwarding with per-core processing and a lock-free hot path; responses go from backend to client directly.
C++23, concepts and modules. Data plane is complete; control plane and management are in progress.

**[speech-analysis-engine](https://github.com/DenChicken/speech-analysis-engine)** — self-hosted system for transcription and analysis of recorded calls.
Recordings are pulled from a CRM, transcribed with faster-whisper and scored against configurable criteria by a local LLM (llama.cpp).
Three services over a shared PostgreSQL database, deployed with Docker on CPU or NVIDIA GPU. No data leaves the server.

**[pulse](https://github.com/DenChicken/pulse)** — C++17 library for synchronizing connection state between two services.
